1.consolidated_definition: El campesino llama jugo de pollo al caldo o extracto de éste al hervirse con sus condimentos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The peasant refers to the broth or extract of chicken as "jugo de pollo" when it is cooked with its seasonings.
